policy_name: OpenAPI Local Reference Resolution and Closure Policy
governing_benchmark: Contract Fragility Schema Complexity Benchmark (Stage B)
epistemic_mandate: Reference resolution must be deterministic, strictly local, root-bounded, cycle-safe, depth-limited, and fail-closed. No network calls or unbounded traversals are permitted. All resolved targets and source references must be cryptographically recorded in reference closures.

local_confinement.rule: References may only resolve to files located strictly within the pinned candidate source directory root.
local_confinement.enforcement: Canonical path resolution followed by relative root confinement assertion.

zero_remote_calls.rule: Remote URI schemes (http, https, ftp, file) are strictly prohibited.
zero_remote_calls.enforcement: Regex check on URI scheme prefix before any resolution.

zero_absolute_paths.rule: Absolute filesystem paths (e.g., '/path' or 'C:\path') are strictly prohibited.
zero_absolute_paths.enforcement: Check on root prefix before filesystem lookup.

cycle_safety.rule: Circular reference graphs must be detected and rejected fail-closed.
cycle_safety.enforcement: Call stack tracking of (file_path, json_pointer) pairs.

bounded_traversal.rule: Transitive reference resolution must not exceed the declared depth bound.
bounded_traversal.enforcement: Depth counter incremented on every transitive reference hop.

fail_closed_missing_targets.rule: If any referenced local file or fragment pointer does not exist on disk, extraction fails closed immediately.
fail_closed_missing_targets.enforcement: Disk existence check and pointer navigation check.

error_code_registry.ERR_REMOTE_REF_PROHIBITED: Reference defines a remote URL scheme which violates the zero-network policy.
error_code_registry.ERR_ABSOLUTE_PATH_PROHIBITED: Reference defines an absolute filesystem path which violates portable relative resolution.
error_code_registry.ERR_PATH_TRAVERSAL_DETECTED: Reference attempts to navigate outside the pinned candidate source directory root.
error_code_registry.ERR_LOCAL_REF_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Referenced target file does not exist on disk within the pinned bundle.
error_code_registry.ERR_REFERENCE_CYCLE_DETECTED: Reference resolution encountered a cyclic reference loop.
error_code_registry.ERR_REF_DEPTH_EXCEEDED: Transitive reference resolution exceeded the maximum allowed depth bound of 8.
error_code_registry.ERR_FRAGMENT_NOT_FOUND: JSON Pointer fragment does not exist in the target document.
error_code_registry.ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DOC_FORMAT: Referenced document is not valid JSON or YAML.
